items.reply: I retain TP: the changed launch exercises the newly gated command, but assertNoMessage checks only stdout, and the distribution extension does not assert successful exit. The new feature-disabled branch returns an error without that stdout message, so this test passes without executing metadata generation. testCompatible supplies --file and therefore does not verify successful execution with the output option omitted. Although the weak assertion predates this PR, the PR changes this test’s invocation and introduces the early-return path it fails to detect; this is a behavioral test gap, not merely tidying.
